violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WEARING GLOVES WHILE PREPARING RAW SHRIMP, THEN TOUCHED TABLET, THEN COVERED PAN WITH CELLOPHANE, THEN TOUCHED WALK IN COOLER HANDLE.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS HAD MANAGER EDUCATE EMPLOYEE ON PROPER GLOVE USE AND WHEN TO WASH HANDS AND CHANGE GLOVES DURING TASK CHANGES.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: OBSERVED LOW TEMPERATURE, CHEMICAL SANITIZING DISH MACHINE DISPENSING 0PPM CHLORINE SANITIZER SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: CFM WILL USE DISH MACHINE TO WASH AND RINSE SOILED DISHWARE, AND 3 COMPARTMENT SINK SET UP TO SANITIZE ALL DISHWARE USING QUARTERNARY AMMONIA. CFM WILL CALL FOR IMMEDIATE SERVICE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED PORK RIBS AT 47F, RAW BEEF AT 42F, RAW CHICKEN AT 46F, RAW SALMON AT 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EMPLOYEE STATED ITEMS WERE MOVED FROM WALK-IN OR RECENTLY PREPED (<1 HOUR) AND PLACED IN UNIT. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO MOVE ALL FOODS TO WORKING REFRIGERATION UNIT. NO FOODS STORED IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed two spray bottles of insect repellent stored on shelf at server expo station.
violations.corrective_action: Remove pesticides from facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CFM discarded spray bottles of insect repellent.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2DWR/COLD RAIL, 4 DWR REF.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EMPLOYEE REPLACED THERMOMETER IN DWR/COLD RAIL.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES WITH OIL AND WATER ON COOKLINE NOT LABELLED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM WILL HAVE EMPLOYEE LABEL BOTTLES.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: OBSERVED PRESENCE OF FRUIT FLIES, PARTICULARLY IN BAR AREA. BAR AREA OBSERVED WITH STICKY RESIDUE FROM DRINKS.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. CLEAN BAR AREA - FLOORS, ALL SURFACES, INTERIOR/EXTERIOR OF EQUIPMENT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: LOW TEMPERATURE, CHEMICAL DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM CALLED FROM IMMEDIATE SERVICE. ALL SANITIZING WILL OCCUR IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 6 DWR REF UNIT OBSERVED AT 40F, BUT FOOD IN UNIT WAS NOT AT PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE. EMPLOYEE NOTED THAT THEY WERE AWARE UNIT HAS ISSUES HOLDING TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE ALL TCS FOOD FROM UNIT. CFM CALLED FOR SERVICE. NO FOOD IS TO BE STORED IN UNIT UNTIL ABLE TO MAINTAIN 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Equipment Cooking Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment were observed soiled with an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris: all refrigeration units, cookline equipment, hood.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue and other debris to maintain a sanitary work environment and prevent pest attraction. Perform deep clean of interior/exterior of refrigeration units, surfaces of all cookline equipment, request additional cleaning of all hood systems.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed accumulation of grease, dust, food debris, on floors, walls, ceilings, surfaces of equipment throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Perform deep clean of entire kitchen and all equipment services.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed several ceiling lights throughout kitchen without protective cover.
violations.corrective_action: Replace ceiling light protective covers OR purchase shatterproof bulbs OR purchase protective tubes.
